explanation: Morgan's 1588 translation gave Welsh a standard written form and is often credited with helping it survive. Complete English Bibles existed from the 1530s, but the King James Version came in 1611.

claims.text: William Morgan's complete Welsh translation of the Bible was published in 1588.
The King James Version of the Bible was published in 1611.
Morgan's Bible gave Welsh a standard literary form and is widely credited with helping the language survive.
Complete printed English Bibles existed from the 1530s, beginning with Miles Coverdale's in 1535.
